name: Idler
blurb: Never moves. If you can't beat this, you have a bug.

name: Grower
blurb: Its biggest stack grabs the nearest land it can take.

name: Starter
blurb: Grabs land, then marches on your core when it's big enough.

name: Rusher
blurb: Saves up, then charges straight at your core.

name: Captain
blurb: Expands, defends its core, and attacks when it can win.
